title: Post-transcriptional and Translational Regulation in Eukaryotes
method: Actual saved HTML p.teaching-prose whitespace-delimited visible words; excludes tables, headings, captions, figures, question answers, references, revision and UI. Article count excludes SVG and buttons.

comparator.method: Recounted marked paragraphs from main; this node extends integrated RNA fate and output instead of reproducing initiation mechanics.

scope_review: Visually checked merged January 2026 CSIR–UGC–DBT Unit 3 p.4, separate CSIR syllabus Unit 3 p.3 and archived MP SET 2024 p.3; aligned with approved 3.D.08 roadmap. RNAi mechanisms reserved for 3.D.11; detailed splicing and initiation chemistry remain in 3.B/3.C.
scientific_review: Pass 1: reviewed source records for deadenylation, XRN1/exosome direction, AU-rich elements and TTP/HuR, IRP positional effects, EJC-dependent NMD and exceptions, alternative RNA processing, ZBP1 and maternal polyadenylation, eIF2B and four mammalian kinases, ATF4/GCN4, 4E-BP and LARP1, plant limitations, ribosome profiling interpretation. Added comparison, maternal control and applications to address coverage gaps.

Pass 2: checked learning progression from RNA anatomy to experiment discrimination, examined 50 questions and answers, expanded 16 traps with reasons and test cues, randomized balanced answer positions, added landmark links and corrected diagram-label spacing. Static re-audit verified prose, anchors, SVG labels, local navigation and question answer alignment.

academic_self_review.method: Two separate internal editorial passes; not external peer review. Deductions: selected source access via abstracts/reviews; some examples and diagrams intentionally simplified; some Part B distractors straightforward; no full interactive browser/mobile accessibility test.

limitations: MP SET comparison is an archived 2024 syllabus copy, not a verified current MPPSC-hosted original.
Reference records and accessible reviews/abstracts were checked; not every complete paper was read.
Static source and arithmetic validation, not a full interactive browser/device/accessibility audit.
Immediate unpublished adjacent chapter remains unlinked until published.
GitHub Pages workflow and live availability need separate verification.
